text:
Lina (Sales): Quick sync — Acme's security team pushed back: POC must keep EU customer data and keys in EU, and they want assurance no analytics or metrics export PII off-region. They also asked whether BYOK with HSM-backed keys is possible for the trial. Timeline: kickoff Wed 2026-04-07.

Devin (SE): We can support tenant-level regional pinning for the POC. BYOK into cloud KMS is possible; HSM-backed keys depend on the cloud provider (we support customer-managed keys in all major regions). For metrics/telemetry: we have an option to redact PII and to route raw logs to a customer S3/GCS in-region. Need to confirm whether their definition of PII includes IPs/UA strings.

Acme_POC: Yes they consider IP addresses and request headers as personal data. Also: can you confirm whether any async batching jobs (e.g., embeddings indexing) will send payloads to a central analytics cluster?

Devin (SE): Good catch. For the POC we'll disable any background exports by default. Embeddings indexing/configured eval jobs can be scoped to region; by default our hosted eval pipeline runs in a central analytics region which we'd avoid for this customer. We'll need a config toggle.

Tariq (Security): Request: please add the security questionnaire note — we need a signed statement that for the POC (30 days) no backups or analytics will leave the tenant's pinned region. Also need to see our sub-processor list per region and our data flow diagram. I'll draft the statement but need infra confirmation.

Ella (Infra): Ops notes: to get full in-region residency for the POC we must: 1) create tenant routing entry, 2) provision customer KMS key or accept BYOK, 3) configure log sink to customer bucket in-region, 4) disable cross-region analytics jobs. Estimated lead time 8-16 hours if BYOK key material is provided; if we need HSM import workflows it adds 24-48 hours for key escrow and validation.

Lina (Sales): Pricing/ops asks from Acme: one-time POC setup fee, monthly per-region KMS surcharge, and whether SLA changes if we pin to a single region. They also asked if there's an extra charge for disabling analytics (sounds like a weird request).

Devin (SE): Ballpark POC price (internal): 
- One-time setup: $700 (routing + log sink + config)
- BYOK/HSM key handling: $150 one-time import + $80/month key management per region
- Analytics isolation work: waived for POC but for production we'd treat it as a security isolation project (TBD)
- SLA: no change for POC; production multi-region availability SLA needs separate SLAs and reserved capacity.

Acme_POC: Can you show the SDK call to set a tenant's preferred region and how to check effective region? We need to include it in our onboarding doc.

Devin (SE): SDK example (node):
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwoodai/sdk');
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY);
await client.tenants.update('tenant-acme', { pinRegion: 'europe-west1', kmsKey: 'projects/acme/locations/europe-west1/keyRdw' });
const routing = await client.tenants.getRouting('tenant-acme');
console.log(routing.effectiveRegion);
```

Tariq (Security): Also need to confirm logs/metadata fields we consider PII. We tag: ip_address, request_headers.user_agent, and any user-provided fields labeled PII. Provide mapping by EOD so I can sign off.

Ella (Infra): Action items for infra: 1) deliver per-region sub-processor list (EU, APAC) by EOD, 2) confirm HSM import lead time, 3) produce short data flow snip showing where control-plane metadata may go. I'll post updates here.

compliance-bot: Compliance doc bundle prepared (SOC2/ISO) — link: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/poc-bundle-2400012345 (access: redwood staff + vendor token).

Lina (Sales): I'll send the POC quote and the SDK snippet to Acme and ask for BYOK material if they want HSM import. @tariq_security will you provide the sign-off statement draft once infra confirms?

Acme_POC: Thanks — please include a short note in the quote that control-plane billing/audit metadata can be routed to our EU bucket for the POC. That will be a hard requirement.

Ella (Infra): Confirmed: we can route control-plane audit logs to customer-controlled EU bucket for POC. Putting it on the queue now.

Tariq (Security): Once infra posts sub-processor list I'll validate and return a signed note for the 30-day POC.

Lina (Sales): Great. Keeping timeline tight for Wed kickoff. I'll follow up with a sales order and the compliance packet.
